headline: Massive Fire Hits PT Fonusa Agung Mulia Candy Factory In Cikande
seoTitle: PT Fonusa Agung Mulia Fire In Cikande
metaDescription: A large fire at PT Fonusa Agung Mulia candy factory in Cikande, Banten has left dozens of employees missing and rescue teams searching for victims.
aiSummaryBullets: A major fire broke out at the PT Fonusa Agung Mulia candy factory located in Cikande, Banten.
Local authorities report that 42 employees are currently unaccounted for following the incident.
Emergency response teams, including Basarnas and local disaster management, are conducting search and evacuation efforts.
aiContextParagraph: A significant industrial fire occurred at the PT Fonusa Agung Mulia candy factory in Cikande, Serang Regency, Banten. Emergency services were deployed following reports that numerous staff members remained trapped inside the burning facility. While four individuals have been confirmed to have sustained minor injuries, local disaster management agencies and regional police have received reports that 42 employees are currently missing or have lost contact. The Governor of Banten and the regional police chief have arrived at the scene to oversee the response operations. Basarnas has also mobilized rescue teams to assist with the ongoing search for those who may be trapped within the factory premises. Firefighting efforts have been intensive as authorities attempt to manage the blaze and secure the area for emergency personnel to carry out their rescue duties in the aftermath of the event.
whyItIsViral: The incident has gained significant attention due to reports of dozens of missing workers, leading to high-velocity coverage across three major news outlets.
